decision.explanation: The question asks 'When was the Turkish Republican Party founded?' Two distinct parties are mentioned in the sources: (1) the Republican Party in Turkey, and (2) the Republican Turkish Party (CTP) in Northern Cyprus. Document D1S4 and D1S5 state that the Republican Party in Turkey was founded on 4 September 1972. Document D4S2 states that the Republican Turkish Party (CTP) in Northern Cyprus was founded in 1970. These are separate political entities with overlapping names, and both claims are valid within their respective contexts. Therefore, both answers are accepted as distinct and complementary.
